## About
City Home & Garden is an indoor plant store in the Downtown Los Angeles Flower District. We carry houseplants, orchids, pottery, soil and plant care supplies, and we offer planting services, custom arrangements and local delivery.
We serve plant lovers, designers, florists, offices, plant shops and resellers. Come by to choose plants and pottery for your home, store, office or event, or bring your own container and we'll plant it for you.
We're rated 4.8 from 100 Google reviews.

## Services
- Indoor plants: Popular houseplants, tropical plants, statement plants, and fresh weekly selections.
- Orchids and special plants: Premium orchids and special plants for collectors, gifts, interiors, and displays.
- Pottery and plant care supplies: Pottery, soil, fertilizer, bamboo stakes, moss poles, and everyday plant care items.
- Planting Service: Bring your plant and pot together, or choose both at our shop, and ask us about planting.
- Custom arrangements: Plant arrangements for retail customers, offices, stores, gifts, and commercial spaces.
- Local Delivery: Don't worry about getting large plants or pottery home. Local delivery is available, with setup for commercial projects too.
- Wholesale plants and supplies: Indoor plants, orchids, pottery and plant care supplies for qualified plant, flower, design, and resale businesses.

## FAQ
Q: Can I bring my own pot?
A: Yes. Choose pottery from our shop or bring your own container, and we can help with planting.

Q: How do I buy wholesale?
A: Wholesale is for qualified plant, flower, design and resale businesses. Please bring a valid resale certificate related to the flower or plant business.

Q: Are you open on Sunday?
A: Sunday hours vary, so please call to confirm before you come in.
